releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.192: Smart Reminder and Personal Calendar ring unanswered repeats exactly at the selected Snooze interval and stop after the configured repeat limit. Manual Snooze shares the same limit; Done cancels repeats. Existing daily repeat, ringtone, saved data and unrelated features are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary web bundle update. Existing saved data and app identity are preserved.
